sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Auto-expand MusicBrainz's native "Annotation" section on entity pages (e.g. /work/<mbid>): the script now clicks the native `a.annotation-toggle` "Show more..." link on load, so a long annotation is fully visible immediately instead of truncated behind an extra manual click. New setting `sa_enable_annotation_auto_expand` (default: on) in a new "📖 ANNOTATION SECTION (Entity Pages)" settings section — unrelated to the existing "📝 ANNOTATION COLUMNS" section, which only affects this script's own rendered table columns.
